group_manifest.proof_strategy: Prove the two inverse dllseg helpers in the group-local case_lib, then process all seven witnesses in manual order. Open xizi_dll and split at the first abstract occurrence for the entailment; choose the easier generated disjunct for each return witness, derive empty/nonempty suffix facts by unfolding xizi_dllseg, and use the reclose helper plus xizi_dll_close where full ownership is required. For the two dispatch wrappers, choose the incoming node sequence as nodes_dispatch_case, construct the anchor, introduce the wand, preserve the supplied xizi_dll resource, and reduce the unified dispatch value to first_value or next_value using node=head or member-not-head facts.

group_entry.proof_strategy: Prove the two inverse dllseg helpers in the group-local case_lib, then process all seven witnesses in manual order. Open xizi_dll and split at the first abstract occurrence for the entailment; choose the easier generated disjunct for each return witness, derive empty/nonempty suffix facts by unfolding xizi_dllseg, and use the reclose helper plus xizi_dll_close where full ownership is required. group_entry.natural_language_proof_pattern: One predicate-first family: open/split/reclose a circular DLL at the queried abstract node, then use the same first-occurrence and dispatch equalities to justify both the low-level returns and the high-level branch wrappers.
proving_hints: Use xizi_dll_open, xizi_dll_close, and xizi_dllseg_unfold from the current common library; unfold xizi_dllseg directly only for the start=stop empty-suffix contradiction.
Use the two proved first-occurrence/dispatch lemmas already present in the frozen case_lib; do not modify their statements.
For return_wit_1 choose its second Coq disjunct; for return_wit_2 and return_wit_3 choose their second disjuncts; for return_wit_4 choose its first disjunct.
Every candidate helper declaration must be suffixed __dll_dispatch_and_reclose and fully proved in the group-local case_lib.
Do not add spec definitions, alter generated definitions, or alter witness statements.
group_entry.grouping_reason: All seven witnesses belong to one function and share the same xizi_dll/xizi_dllseg ownership plus first-occurrence/dispatch helper family. A single worker can prove the two inverse segment helpers once and reuse them across entailment, return, and wrapper obligations; splitting would duplicate suffixed helpers. The group has 7 witnesses, below max_witnesses_per_group=12.

per_witness_plan.proof_of_DoubleLinkListGetNext_entail_wi: Destruct the anchor. For node=head, open xizi_dll and instantiate the sentinel alternative. For In node nodes, obtain the first-occurrence before/after pair, apply the split helper, instantiate the member alternative, and use the existing dispatch-at-first-occurrence lemma.
per_witness_plan.proof_of_DoubleLinkListGetNext_return_wi: Choose the second disjunct, destruct nodes_dispatch_case, eliminate the impossible nonempty start=stop dllseg branch, instantiate first_2 with first/head, and reduce sentinel dispatch over nil to 0.
Choose the second disjunct. The tail dllseg starts and stops at head, so nodes_after=nil; combine this with PreH6 for the zero result, then reclose the two segments around linklist_node_pre.
Choose the second disjunct. Rewrite nodes_after=node_next::l0 so first_value nodes_after=node_next, use PreH7 for the result equality, then reclose the segments.
Choose the first disjunct, unfold the non-stop leading dllseg to obtain nodes_dispatch_case=first::rest, reduce first_value to first, and close the sentinel links plus segment with xizi_dll_close.
per_witness_plan.proof_of_DoubleLinkListGetNext_derive_se: Choose nodes_dispatch_case=nodes_sentinel_case, prove the anchor by node=head, frame the input xizi_dll into the dispatch precondition, introduce the wand, and use dispatch-at-head reduction to build the branch result from the supplied dispatch result.
per_witness_plan.proof_of_DoubleLinkListGetNext_derive_me: Choose nodes_dispatch_case=nodes_member_case, prove the anchor by In, derive node<>head through first-occurrence split/reclose while retaining xizi_dll, introduce the wand, and unfold dispatch with node<>head so the supplied result equals xizi_double_link_next_value.
